g.text: Identity flows into groups, groups into scopes, and governance sits on the same scopes
The access model you end up with
Azure Policy · resource locks · budget — bound to the same scopes, independent of RBAC
four personas, three assigned-membership security groups, one B2B guest
Owner once at the subscription, Contributor and Reader per resource group
tag and location policies, CanNotDelete locks on prod and platform, a $100 budget
Malfurion Stormrage SkyCraft-Admins Owner subscription, inherited by all RGs
Chromie Timewalker SkyCraft-Testers Reader dev + prod, read only
Illidan Stormrage none (B2B guest) Reader platform-skycraft-swc-rg
# roles land on groups, never on people — except the guest, scoped directly
